title: On sliding methods for mixed local and nonlocal equations and Gibbons' conjecture
summary: We investigate elliptic and parabolic equations involving mixed local and nonlocal operators of the form $(-Δ)^s-Δ$, as well as their parabolic counterparts with both the Marchaud fractional time derivative and the classical first-order derivative. A major difficulty in this setting stems from the coexistence of operators with different nonlocal structures and incompatible scaling properties, which obstruct the direct use of classical sliding methods.
